title: Backward sweep over a tape zone
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-work-tape machine, let $\alpha$ be an action, and let $j\in\mathbb{Z}$ and $n\in\mathbb{N}$. A right-to-left sweep through the reversed zone of $n$ read-marked blocks, initialized with the head flags at coordinate $j+n$, finishes with the head flags at coordinate $j$ and produces the reversed zone of unread blocks from the configuration obtained by applying $\alpha$ to $c$.
hypotheses_covered: An action $\alpha$ for the same machine
replaced:
Let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-work-tape machine, $\alpha$ an action of that
machine, $j \in \mathbb{Z}$, and $n \in \mathbb{N}$. The backward sweep for $\alpha$
over the reversed concatenation of the $n$ read-marked blocks at coordinates
$j, \dots, j+n-1$, started from the table of head flags at coordinate $j+n$, ends in the
table of head flags at $j$ and produces the reversed unread blocks of the configuration
obtained by applying $\alpha$ to $c$.
